text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired: PD #84278 — High GPU memory allocation failure rate in us-west1 pool-3. Error samples: "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" and "cudaMalloc failed". Auto-repeat suppression: off.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered on-call runbook: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/84278. Escalation policy: oncall-sre -> eng-lead after 5m.

jess: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs from the most recent allocations.

triage-sre: i'm pulling node telemetry now, looks like memory usage trending up on gpus 0-3 on node-uw1-03. kvcache evictions spiking.

carlos: FYI — we've seen similar kvcache fragmentation on this pool last month; may be correlation with long-context chat workload.

jess: slicing the logs: found repeated pattern: 
```
2026-03-15T21:45:12Z model-worker: CUDA alloc 0x7f... failed size=230MB
model-worker: fallback to cpu unsuccessful
```

jess: running: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-worker -c runtime --since=10m | grep cuda` to get broader context.

triage-sre: nodes in pool-3: 12/12 healthy but mem reserved high. nvtop shows one pod pinned to GPU0 using 98% VRAM.

mike: who's owning that hot pod? can we restart it or move it?

carlos: pod is `chat-service-ctxlong-7b-0`. That's a stateful workload with pinned cache. Restarting will drop KV cache — will increase latency for a bit.

jess: quick mitigation options: 1) cordon+drain the node with the hot pod (evict other pods), 2) soft-restart the chat pod only, 3) scale up pool-3 temporarily and autoscale routing. Thoughts?

mike: do 1) if we can migrate safely. If customer-facing routes impacted, prefer scaling first.

triage-sre: customer impact check: current request error rate for hostnames using pool-3 is 2.7% for gen endpoints, up from 0.2% baseline. Error spikes correlate with cuda alloc failures.

jess: creating a short-term routing rule to divert new sessions from pool-3 to pool-2. Applying now: `infractl route set --exclude-pool pool-3 --for minutes=15 --reason "OOM mitigation"`

incident-bot: Routing rule applied by jess — exclude pool-3 for 15m.

pagerduty: Auto-escalation timer: 5m until eng-lead paged.

carlos: while routing change propagates, I'm going to try a graceful restart of the chat pod to free up kvcache fragments. Will annotate with `oom-mitigate/incident-84278`.

jess: thanks. Please also capture a heap profile before restart if possible. `gdb` dump or runtime heap profile would be great.

carlos: got a quick heapdump saved to s3://redwood-logs/84278/heap-chat-7b-0-2103.gz

triage-sre: node-uw1-03 memory reclaimed after restart, GPU usage dropped to normal. kv-cache eviction rate returned to baseline.

mike: any sign of a regression in model-worker after restart?

jess: latency for the chat endpoint spiked 400ms for ~2 minutes post-restart, then stabilized. Error rate returned to ~0.3%. Good so far.

pagerduty: Incident owner jess acknowledged, incident status: investigating.

carlos: note: root cause likely gradual VRAM fragmentation combined with one long-context job that held more allocations than before. I'll open a ticket to add preemptive fragmentation defrag and a rolling restart policy for pinned cache pods.

jess: next steps: - keep routing exclusion for 30m and monitor - run a targeted drain on node-uw1-03 later in maintenance window - create follow-up ticket for kvcache defrag + model-worker memory caps

triage-sre: monitoring: added a temporary alert alarm to detect >15% sustained cuda alloc error rate over 1m and also added node-level slab/fragmentation counters to dashboards.

mike: i'm taking the handoff in 15m. jess, please summarize status for the eng-lead if they get paged.

jess: summary for eng-lead: PD#84278 — GPU allocation failures in us-west1 pool-3. Root cause: VRAM fragmentation + a single long-context pod. Mitigation: diverted new traffic off pool-3, restarted offending pod, error rate down to baseline. Follow-ups created: DEF-1243 (defrag + caps) and OPS-789 (auto-restart policy).

incident-bot: PagerDuty note added by jess.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: escalated to eng-lead if unacked in 5m. Currently acknowledged by jess.

mike: taking over now. jess — can you drop the link to the heapdump and tickets in the incident ticket?

jess: done. heapdump: s3://redwood-logs/84278/heap-chat-7b-0-2103.gz. Tickets: https://redwood.example/DEF-1243, https://redwood.example/OPS-789.

carlos: tagging this as postmortem candidate if we see recurrence.

mike: thanks all. I'll watch for flapping and re-open routing if needed. Please slack me if it creeps back up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed by jess (status: monitoring).
